text: Designing expressive Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) is an important topic in graph machine learning fields. Despite the existence of numerous approaches proposed to enhance GNNs based on Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) tests, what GNNs can and cannot learn still lacks a deeper understanding.
Additionally, we introduce novel methods that can provably enhance GNNs' ability to capture complex dependencies and make complex predictions.
Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approaches.
